The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: User Management ASIM filtering parser for Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail
properties.query:
// Ims: RAM identity management (users, groups, access keys, login profiles, MFA)
// CloudSSO: Alibaba Cloud SSO directory (SSO users, groups, MFA, access assignments)
// Ram: roles and policy attachment
// Only API calls whose subject is a user, a role or a group are normalized. Account-level
// policy/report/configuration reads, identity-provider and application configuration, and
// authentication events are dropped.
// ActionTrail never carries the pre-change value of a modified property, so
// PreviousPropertyValue is not populated and is not projected.
let vimUserManagementAlibabaCloudActionTrail = (
    starttime: datetime = datetime(null)
    , endtime: datetime = datetime(null)
    , srcipaddr_has_any_prefix: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , targetusername_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , actorusername_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , eventtype_in: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , disabled: bool = false
    , pack: bool = false
) {
    // Alibaba redacts selected values as "***". Observed only on UserName, NewEmail, NewDisplayName and GroupName.
    let _Unredact = (v: string) { iff(v == "***", "", v) };
    let UserManagementEventLookup = datatable(
        serviceName: string
        , eventName: string
        , _EventTypeBase: string
    )
    [
        "Ims", "AddUserToGroup",                  "UserAddedToGroup",
        "Ims", "ChangePassword",                  "PasswordChanged",
        "Ims", "CreateAccessKey",                 "UserModified",
        "Ims", "CreateGroup",                     "GroupCreated",
        "Ims", "CreateUser",                      "UserCreated",
        "Ims", "DeleteAccessKey",                 "UserModified",
        "Ims", "DeleteGroup",                     "GroupDeleted",
        "Ims", "DeleteLoginProfile",              "UserModified",
        "Ims", "DeleteUser",                      "UserDeleted",
        "Ims", "DisableVirtualMFA",               "UserModified",
        "Ims", "GetAccessKeyLastUsed",            "UserRead",
        "Ims", "GetGroup",                        "GroupRead",
        "Ims", "GetLoginProfile",                 "UserRead",
        "Ims", "GetUser",                         "UserRead",
        "Ims", "GetUserMFAInfo",                  "UserRead",
        "Ims", "GetUserPersonalDingTalkInfo",     "UserRead",
        "Ims", "GetVerificationInfo",             "UserRead",
        "Ims", "ListAccessKeys",                  "UserRead",
        "Ims", "ListGroups",                      "GroupEnumerated",
        "Ims", "ListGroupsForUser",               "UserRead",
        "Ims", "ListPasskeys",                    "UserRead",
        "Ims", "ListUserBasicInfos",              "UserRead",
        "Ims", "ListUsers",                       "UserRead",
        "Ims", "ListUsersForGroup",               "GroupRead",
        "Ims", "ListUsersInRecycleBin",           "UserRead",
        "Ims", "RemoveUserFromGroup",             "UserRemovedFromGroup",
        "Ims", "RestoreAccessKeyFromRecycleBin",  "UserModified",
        "Ims", "SendVerificationLink",            "UserModified",
        "Ims", "SetVerificationInfo",             "UserModified",
        "Ims", "UnbindMFADevice",                 "UserModified",
        "Ims", "UnbindVerification",              "UserModified",
        "Ims", "UpdateAccessKey",                 "UserModified",
        "Ims", "UpdateGroup",                     "GroupModified",
        "Ims", "UpdateLoginProfile",              "UserModified",
        "Ims", "UpdateUser",                      "UserModified",
        "Ims", "UpdateUserProvisionType",         "UserModified",
        "CloudSSO", "AddUserToGroup",             "UserAddedToGroup",
        "CloudSSO", "ChangePassword",             "PasswordChanged",
        "CloudSSO", "CreateAccessAssignment",     "UserModified",          // GroupModified when PrincipalType is Group
        "CloudSSO", "CreateCloudCredential",      "UserModified",
        "CloudSSO", "CreateGroup",                "GroupCreated",
        "CloudSSO", "CreateUser",                 "UserCreated",
        "CloudSSO", "CreateUserProvisioning",     "UserModified",          // GroupModified when PrincipalType is Group
        "CloudSSO", "DeleteAccessAssignment",     "UserModified",          // GroupModified when PrincipalType is Group
        "CloudSSO", "DeleteGroup",                "GroupDeleted",
        "CloudSSO", "DeleteMFADeviceForUser",     "UserModified",
        "CloudSSO", "DeleteUser",                 "UserDeleted",
        "CloudSSO", "DeleteUserProvisioning",     "UserModified",          // GroupModified when PrincipalType is Group
        "CloudSSO", "GetGroup",                   "GroupRead",
        "CloudSSO", "GetNewMFADevice",            "UserModified",
        "CloudSSO", "GetProvisionedRamUser",      "UserRead",
        "CloudSSO", "GetUser",                    "UserRead",
        "CloudSSO", "ListGroupMembers",           "GroupRead",
        "CloudSSO", "ListGroups",                 "GroupEnumerated",
        "CloudSSO", "ListJoinedGroupsForUser",    "UserRead",
        "CloudSSO", "ListMFADevices",             "UserRead",
        "CloudSSO", "ListMFADevicesForUser",      "UserRead",
        "CloudSSO", "ListUsers",                  "UserRead",
        "CloudSSO", "RegisterMFADevice",          "UserModified",
        "CloudSSO", "RemoveUserFromGroup",        "UserRemovedFromGroup",
        "CloudSSO", "ResetUserPassword",          "PasswordReset",         // admin acting on another user
        "CloudSSO", "UpdateGroup",                "GroupModified",
        "CloudSSO", "UpdateUser",                 "UserModified",
        "CloudSSO", "UpdateUserStatus",           "UserModified",          // UserDisabled / UserEnabled by NewStatus
        "CloudSSO", "VerifyMFADevice",            "UserModified",
        "Ram", "AttachPolicyToRole",              "UserModified",
        "Ram", "CreateRole",                      "UserCreated",
        "Ram", "CreateServiceLinkedRole",         "UserCreated",
        "Ram", "DeleteRole",                      "UserDeleted",
        "Ram", "DetachPolicyFromRole",            "UserModified",
        "Ram", "GetAccessKeyLastUsed",            "UserRead",
        "Ram", "GetLoginProfile",                 "UserRead",
        "Ram", "GetRole",                         "UserRead",
        "Ram", "GetUser",                         "UserRead",
        "Ram", "GetUserMFAInfo",                  "UserRead",
        "Ram", "ListAccessKeys",                  "UserRead",
        "Ram", "ListGroups",                      "GroupEnumerated",
        "Ram", "ListGroupsForUser",               "UserRead",
        "Ram", "ListPoliciesForGroup",            "GroupRead",
        "Ram", "ListPoliciesForRole",             "UserRead",
        "Ram", "ListPoliciesForUser",             "UserRead",
        "Ram", "ListRoles",                       "UserRead",
        "Ram", "ListRolesForService",             "UserRead",
        "Ram", "ListUsers",                       "UserRead",
        "Ram", "ListUsersForGroup",               "GroupRead",
        "Ram", "UpdateRole",                      "UserModified"
    ];
    // Single source of truth for the pre-lookup name filter to prevent drift
    let _SupportedEventNames = UserManagementEventLookup | distinct eventName;
    // TargetUserScope by service, mirroring the AWS parser's EventSourceNameLookup.
    let ServiceScopeLookup = datatable(serviceName: string , TargetUserScope: string)
    [
        "CloudSSO", "CloudSSO",
        "Ims",      "RAM",
        "Ram",      "RAM"
    ];
    AliCloudActionTrailLogs_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    | where serviceName in ("Ims", "CloudSSO", "Ram") // Only relevant service names
    | where eventName in (_SupportedEventNames)
    | where (isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime)
        and (isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime)
    | where array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0
        or has_any_ipv4_prefix(sourceIpAddress, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix)
    | lookup UserManagementEventLookup on serviceName, eventName
    | where isnotempty(_EventTypeBase) // Dropping combinations not defined above
    | extend
        _ActorUserIdentityType = tostring(userIdentity.type)
        // Fall back to ensure mandatory field is never empty
        , _ActorUsernameRaw = coalesce(
            tostring(userIdentity.userName),
            tostring(userIdentity.principalId),
            tostring(userIdentity.accountId))
    | extend
        ActorUsername = iff(
            _ActorUserIdentityType == "assumed-role",
            tostring(split(_ActorUsernameRaw, ":")[-1]),
            _ActorUsernameRaw)
    | where array_length(actorusername_has_any) == 0
        or ActorUsername has_any (actorusername_has_any)
    | extend
        _PrincipalType = coalesce(
            tostring(requestParameters.PrincipalType),
            tostring(responseElements.UserProvisioning.PrincipalType)
        )
        , _EventType = case(
            // CloudSSO UpdateUserStatus enables or disables the target user depending on NewStatus.
            serviceName == "CloudSSO" and eventName == "UpdateUserStatus"
                and tostring(requestParameters.NewStatus) =~ "Disabled", "UserDisabled"
            , serviceName == "CloudSSO" and eventName == "UpdateUserStatus"
                and tostring(requestParameters.NewStatus) =~ "Enabled", "UserEnabled"
            // CloudSSO access assignments and user provisioning target a user or a group, by PrincipalType.
            , serviceName == "CloudSSO"
                and eventName in (
                    "CreateAccessAssignment", "DeleteAccessAssignment",
                    "CreateUserProvisioning", "DeleteUserProvisioning"
                )
                and coalesce(
                    tostring(requestParameters.PrincipalType),
                    tostring(responseElements.UserProvisioning.PrincipalType)
                ) =~ "Group", "GroupModified"
            // Ims UpdateLoginProfile can be multiple things
            , serviceName == "Ims" and eventName == "UpdateLoginProfile"
                and (
                    tostring(requestParameters.GenerateRandomPassword) =~ "true"
                    or tostring(requestParameters.PasswordResetRequired) =~ "true"
                    or isnotempty(tostring(requestParameters.Password))
                ), "PasswordReset"
            , serviceName == "Ims" and eventName == "UpdateLoginProfile"
                and tostring(requestParameters.Status) =~ "Inactive", "UserDisabled"
            , serviceName == "Ims" and eventName == "UpdateLoginProfile"
                and tostring(requestParameters.Status) =~ "Active", "UserEnabled"
            , _EventTypeBase
        )
    | where array_length(eventtype_in) == 0 or _EventType in (eventtype_in)
    | extend
        _TargetUsername = case(
            serviceName == "CloudSSO", coalesce(
                _Unredact(tostring(responseElements.User.UserName)),
                tostring(responseElements.UserProvisioning.PrincipalName),
                _Unredact(tostring(requestParameters.UserName)))
            , serviceName == "Ims", coalesce(
                tostring(responseElements.User.UserPrincipalName),
                tostring(requestParameters.UserPrincipalName),
                _Unredact(tostring(requestParameters.UserName)),
                tostring(requestParameters.NewUserPrincipalName))
            , serviceName == "Ram", coalesce(
                tostring(responseElements.Role.RoleName),
                _Unredact(tostring(responseElements.User.UserName)),
                _Unredact(tostring(requestParameters.UserName)),
                tostring(requestParameters.RoleName))
            , ""
        )
    | where array_length(targetusername_has_any) == 0
        or _TargetUsername has_any (targetusername_has_any)
    | extend
        _ErrorCode = trim(@'"', errorCode)
        , _ActorUserId = tostring(userIdentity.principalId)
        , _ActorAccountId = tostring(userIdentity.accountId)
        , _PrincipalId = coalesce(
            tostring(requestParameters.PrincipalId),
            tostring(responseElements.UserProvisioning.PrincipalId))
    | extend
        // IPv4, IPv6, service FQDNs such as cloudmonitor.aliyuncs.com or 'internal' observed in sourceIpAddress.
        _SrcIsIPv4 = coalesce(ipv4_is_match(sourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0"), false)
        , _SrcIsIPAny = coalesce(ipv6_is_match(sourceIpAddress, "::/0"), false)
    | extend
        _SrcIsIp = _SrcIsIPv4 or _SrcIsIPAny
        , _SrcIsFQDN = not(_SrcIsIPv4)
            and not(_SrcIsIPAny)
            and indexof(sourceIpAddress, ".") > 0
    | extend
        _TargetUserId = case(
            serviceName == "CloudSSO", coalesce(
                tostring(responseElements.User.UserId),
                tostring(requestParameters.UserId),
                tostring(requestParameters.CloudSSOUserId),
                iff(_PrincipalType =~ "User", _PrincipalId, ""))
            , serviceName == "Ims", coalesce(
                tostring(responseElements.User.UserId),
                tostring(requestParameters.UserId))
            // Ram identifies users, roles and groups by name only. Role.Arn is preserved in AdditionalFields.
            , ""
        )
        , _GroupId = case(
            serviceName == "CloudSSO", coalesce(
                tostring(requestParameters.GroupId),
                iff(_PrincipalType =~ "Group", _PrincipalId, ""))
            , serviceName == "Ims", coalesce(
                tostring(responseElements.Group.GroupId),
                tostring(requestParameters.GroupId))
            , ""
        )
        , _GroupName = coalesce(
            _Unredact(tostring(responseElements.Group.GroupName)),
            tostring(requestParameters.GroupName),
            tostring(requestParameters.NewGroupName))
        // A Ram event whose only identity is a role name is acting on a role, not on a RAM user.
        , _TargetIsRole = serviceName == "Ram"
            and isempty(tostring(requestParameters.UserName))
            and isempty(tostring(responseElements.User.UserName))
            and (
                isnotempty(tostring(requestParameters.RoleName))
                or isnotempty(tostring(responseElements.Role.RoleName))
            )
    | extend
        EventCount = int(1)
        , EventStartTime = TimeGenerated
        , EventEndTime = TimeGenerated
        , EventVendor = "Alibaba Cloud"
        , EventProduct = "ActionTrail"
        , EventSchema = "UserManagement"
        , EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0"
        , EventType = _EventType
        , EventResult = iff(
            isempty(_ErrorCode) and isempty(errorMessage), "Success", "Failure"
        )
        , EventResultDetails = case(
            isempty(_ErrorCode) and isempty(errorMessage), ""
            , _ErrorCode has_any (
                "NoPermission", "Forbidden", "AccessDenied",
                "Unauthorized", "403"
            ), "NotAuthorized"
            , errorMessage has_any (
                "not authorized", "no permission", "Forbidden"
            ), "NotAuthorized"
            , "Other"
        )
        , EventOriginalResultDetails = case(
            isnotempty(_ErrorCode), _ErrorCode
            , isnotempty(errorMessage), errorMessage
            , ""
        )
        , EventMessage = errorMessage
        , EventSeverity = iff(
            isnotempty(_ErrorCode) or isnotempty(errorMessage)
            , "Low"
            , "Informational"
        )
        , EventOriginalSubType = eventCategory
        , EventUid = _ItemId
        , Dvc = "ActionTrail"
        , DvcAction = eventRW
        // Actor fields
        // assumed-role principalId/userName are "<roleId-or-roleName>:<sessionName>"; sessionName identifies the human who assumed the role.
        , ActorUserId = iff(
            _ActorUserIdentityType == "assumed-role"
            , tostring(split(_ActorUserId, ":")[0])
            , _ActorUserId
        )
        , ActorUserIdType = iff(isnotempty(_ActorUserId), "Other", "")
        , ActorUserType = case(
            _ActorUserIdentityType == "root-account", "Admin"
            , _ActorUserIdentityType == "system", "System"
            , _ActorUserIdentityType == "assumed-role", "Service Principal"
            , _ActorUserIdentityType in (
                "ram-user", "cloudsso-user", "saml-user",
                "oidc-user", "alibaba-cloud-account"
            ), "Regular"
            , "Other"
        )
        , ActorOriginalUserType = _ActorUserIdentityType
        , ActorScopeId = _ActorAccountId
        // assumed-role principals arrive as "<roleId>:<sessionName>".
        , ActorSessionId = iff(
            _ActorUserId contains ":"
            , tostring(split(_ActorUserId, ":")[1])
            , ""
        )
        // Target fields
        , TargetUserId = _TargetUserId
        , TargetUserIdType = iff(isnotempty(_TargetUserId), "Other", "")
        , TargetUsername = _TargetUsername
        , TargetUserType = case(
            _TargetIsRole, "Service Principal"
            , isnotempty(_TargetUsername) or isnotempty(_TargetUserId), "Regular"
            , ""
        )
        , TargetOriginalUserType = case(
            _TargetIsRole, "ram-role"
            , isempty(_TargetUsername) and isempty(_TargetUserId), ""
            , serviceName == "CloudSSO", "cloudsso-user"
            , "ram-user"
        )
        , TargetUserScopeId = case(
            serviceName == "CloudSSO", coalesce(
                tostring(requestParameters.DirectoryId),
                tostring(responseElements.OwnerId),
                _ActorAccountId)
            , coalesce(tostring(requestParameters.accountId), _ActorAccountId)
        )
        // Group fields
        , GroupId = _GroupId
        , GroupIdType = iff(isnotempty(_GroupId), "Simple", "")
        , GroupName = _GroupName
        , GroupType = iff(isnotempty(_GroupId) or isnotempty(_GroupName), "Other", "")
        , GroupOriginalType = case(
            isempty(_GroupId) and isempty(_GroupName), ""
            , serviceName == "CloudSSO", "CloudSSO Group"
            , "RAM Group"
        )
        // ActionTrail carries no prior value, so only the new value of a changed property is available.
        , NewPropertyValue = coalesce(
            tostring(requestParameters.NewStatus),
            tostring(requestParameters.Status),
            tostring(requestParameters.NewUserPrincipalName),
            tostring(requestParameters.NewGroupName),
            _Unredact(tostring(requestParameters.NewDisplayName)),
            _Unredact(tostring(requestParameters.NewEmail)),
            tostring(requestParameters.NewDescription),
            iff(
                eventName == "UpdateUserProvisionType",
                coalesce(
                    tostring(requestParameters.ProvisionType),
                    tostring(responseElements.User.ProvisionType)),
                ""))
        // App and source
        , ActingAppName = serviceName
        , ActingAppType = iff(isnotempty(serviceName), "Service", "")
        , SrcIpAddr = iff(_SrcIsIp, sourceIpAddress, "")
        , SrcFQDN = iff(_SrcIsFQDN, sourceIpAddress, "")
        , SrcHostname = iff(_SrcIsFQDN, tostring(split(sourceIpAddress, ".")[0]), "")
        , SrcDomain = iff(
            _SrcIsFQDN
            , substring(sourceIpAddress, indexof(sourceIpAddress, ".") + 1)
            , ""
        )
        , SrcDomainType = iff(_SrcIsFQDN, "FQDN", "")
        // "Internal" and any other dotless non-address name belongs in neither SrcIpAddr nor SrcFQDN.
        , SrcDescription = iff(
            not(_SrcIsIp) and not(_SrcIsFQDN) and isnotempty(sourceIpAddress)
            , strcat("ActionTrail non-network source marker: ", sourceIpAddress)
            , ""
        )
    | extend
        // Ims and CloudSSO principal names are UPN-shaped (user@<accountId>.onaliyun.com), Ram user and role names are bare.
        ActorUsernameType = case(
            isempty(ActorUsername), ""
            , ActorUsername contains "@", "UPN"
            , "Simple"
        )
        , TargetUsernameType = case(
            isempty(TargetUsername), ""
            , TargetUsername contains "@", "UPN"
            , "Simple"
        )
        , GroupNameType = iff(isnotempty(GroupName), "Simple", "")
        // Limited options with this source and schema
        , EventSubType = iff(
            EventType in ("PasswordChanged", "PasswordReset"), "password", ""
        )
    | lookup ServiceScopeLookup on serviceName
    | extend
        UpdatedPropertyName = EventSubType
        , Src = coalesce(SrcIpAddr, SrcFQDN)
        , IpAddr = SrcIpAddr
        , User = ActorUsername
    | project-rename
        EventOriginalUid = eventId
        , EventOriginalType = eventName
        , EventProductVersion = eventVersion
        , HttpUserAgent = userAgent
    | extend
        AdditionalFields = iff(
            pack
            , pack(
                "eventType", eventType
                , "eventRW", eventRW
                , "serviceName", serviceName
                , "eventSource", eventSource
                , "sourceIpAddress", sourceIpAddress
                , "requestId", requestId
                , "apiVersion", apiVersion
                , "acsRegion", acsRegion
                , "isGlobal", isGlobal
                , "actorAccessKeyId", tostring(userIdentity.accessKeyId)
                , "principalType", _PrincipalType
                , "roleArn", tostring(responseElements.Role.Arn)
                , "resourceName", resourceName
                , "resourceType", resourceType
                , "requestParameters", requestParameters
                , "responseElements", responseElements
                , "additionalEventData", additionalEventData
                , "referencedResources", referencedResources
            )
            , dynamic(null)
        )
    | project
        TimeGenerated
        , EventCount
        , EventStartTime
        , EventEndTime
        , EventType
        , EventSubType
        , EventResult
        , EventResultDetails
        , EventSeverity
        , EventProduct
        , EventVendor
        , EventSchema
        , EventSchemaVersion
        , EventUid
        , EventOriginalUid
        , EventOriginalType
        , EventOriginalSubType
        , EventOriginalResultDetails
        , EventMessage
        , EventProductVersion
        , Dvc
        , DvcAction
        , ActorUserId
        , ActorUserIdType
        , ActorUsername
        , ActorUsernameType
        , ActorUserType
        , ActorOriginalUserType
        , ActorScopeId
        , ActorSessionId
        , TargetUserId
        , TargetUserIdType
        , TargetUsername
        , TargetUsernameType
        , TargetUserType
        , TargetOriginalUserType
        , TargetUserScope
        , TargetUserScopeId
        , GroupId
        , GroupIdType
        , GroupName
        , GroupNameType
        , GroupType
        , GroupOriginalType
        , UpdatedPropertyName
        , NewPropertyValue
        , ActingAppName
        , ActingAppType
        , HttpUserAgent
        , SrcIpAddr
        , SrcFQDN
        , SrcHostname
        , SrcDomain
        , SrcDomainType
        , SrcDescription
        , Src
        , IpAddr
        , User
        , AdditionalFields
        , Type
};
vimUserManagementAlibabaCloudActionTrail(
    starttime=starttime,
    endtime=endtime,
    srcipaddr_has_any_prefix=srcipaddr_has_any_prefix,
    targetusername_has_any=targetusername_has_any,
    actorusername_has_any=actorusername_has_any,
    eventtype_in=eventtype_in,
    disabled=disabled,
    pack=pack)
